summary: Focana 2.4.5 tightens the Pomodoro break experience and prevents local Electron development builds from reopening after restart.
improvements: Pomodoro break planning, active break, and ready-to-resume windows now use state-specific compact heights so the small desktop window no longer leaves a large empty lower area.
Compact mode now labels Pomodoro breaks as Break time, or Ready to resume when the break has ended, while keeping the current task visible as secondary context.
Local Electron development builds are guarded from native launch-at-login registration so stale development shells do not reopen after a Mac restart.
fixes: The active Pomodoro break countdown and Ready to resume surfaces no longer reuse the taller break-planning window size.
Compact Pomodoro break mode no longer presents the task name as if focus work is still active.
The launch-at-login guard now treats node_modules/electron and process.defaultApp as development-only runtimes.
